newsitem.title: EU: EP ECONOMIC COMMITTEE AGENDA - MAY 20-21.
newsitem.headline: EP ECONOMIC COMMITTEE AGENDA - MAY 20-21.

text.p: Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs and Industrial Policy [[ Tuesday 20 May 1997 ]] SUBCOMMITTEE ON MONETARY AFFAIRS 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE222.581 ) 2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 18-19/3/97 (PE221.854 ) - 8/4/97 (PE222.201 ) - 14-15/4/97 (PE222.205 ) 3. Chairman's announcements 4. Current monetary situation: Bulletin 5/May 1997 5. Meeting with Mr RAVASIO, Director General, DG II, European Commission, on recent developments in the monetary field (at 3 p.m.) - Statement by the Commission 6. Meeting with a representative of the Commission on the question of the CFA Franc in relation to EMU (to be confirmed) - Introductory statement followed by exchange of views 7. International dimension of the Euro (SNA0184 ) - Rapporteur: Mr RUFFOLO (PE221.838 ) - Exchange of views 8. Stability pact (third phase of EMU) - excessive deficits (T05039) **II SYN96247 COM(97)0116 C4-0174/97 CNS96248 COM(97)0117 C4-0159/97 + ECON Fond R CHRISTODOULOU Efthym (PPE) (PE222.194 ) - Consideration of amendments 9. New technologies and money (SNA0183 ) - Rapporteur: Mr STEVENS (PE221.251 ) - Exchange of views ===] Wednesday 21 May, 9 a.m. 10. EMI annual report (T05380) COS0541 C4-175/97 C4-0175/97 + ECON Fond R MEZZAROMA Roberto. (UPE) (PE222.188 ) - Consideration of amendments 11. Monetary policy in Stage 3 (EMI report, January 1997) (T05381) COS0519 C4-043/97 C4-0043/97 + ECON Fond R ETTL Harald. (PSE) (PE221.834 ) - Consideration of amendments 12. Coordination of budgetary and tax policies in monetary union (T03944) INI0348 INI0348 + ECON Fond R FOURCANS Andre. (PPE) (PE221.271 ) - Consideration of amendments 13. Hearing on the introduction of the Euro and the travel and tourism sector (see separate programme) (from 10 a.m.) - Hearing of experts 14. Any other business 15. Date of next meeting (PE/IV/OJ/97-08/MONE ) - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
